channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-134731 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability was detected in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /insertClient.php. The manipulation of the argument client_id results in sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

item.title: CVE-2026-134732 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A flaw has been found in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. This affects the function ASEImporter::InternReadFile of the file code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp of the component ASE File Importer. This manipulation causes out-of-bounds write. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 6.0.6 mitigates this issue. Patch name: 7ccc44a338dcdcc81023484388126ab1a8250e94. You should upgrade the affected component.

item.title: CVE-2026-134733 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability has been found in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file booking.php. Such manipulation of the argument venue_id leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

item.title: CVE-2026-134734 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | A vulnerability was found in Webkul Bagisto up to 2.4.13. Affected is the function RazorpayController::paymentSuccess of the file packages/Webkul/Razorpay/src/Http/Controllers/RazorpayController.php of the component Payment Gateway Success/Callback Controllers. Performing a manipulation results in insufficient verification of data authenticity. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 2.4.14 is able to address this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

item.title: CVE-2026-134735 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | A vulnerability was determined in Webkul Bagisto up to 2.4.12. Affected by this vulnerability is the function Success of the file packages/Webkul/PayU/src/Http/Controllers/PayUController.php of the component Payu Payment Gateway. Executing a manipulation of the argument Status can lead to insufficient verification of data authenticity. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 2.4.13 addresses this issue. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

item.title: CVE-2026-134779 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A weakness has been identified in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.6. The affected element is the function Assimp::ColladaLoader::CreateAnimation of the file code/AssetLib/Collada/ColladaLoader.cpp of the component Collada Loader. This manipulation of the argument mSize causes out-of-bounds write. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

item.title: CVE-2026-134780 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A security vulnerability has been detected in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.6. The impacted element is the function Assimp::JoinVerticesProcess::ProcessMesh of the file code/PostProcessing/JoinVerticesProcess.cpp of the component PostProcessing JoinVerticesProcess. Such manipulation leads to out-of-bounds write. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-134781 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability was detected in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.5. This affects the function Assimp::PretransformVertices::BuildMeshRefCountArray of the file PretransformVertices.cpp. Performing a manipulation results in out-of-bounds write. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-134820 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI parser that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to desynchronize request framing by sending malformed framing headers. Attackers can send whitespace-padded Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length headers, signed Content-Length values, or invalid chunk terminators to smuggle requests past front-end proxies to the ASGI application.

item.title: CVE-2026-134821 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI HTTP/1 parser that buffers protocol lines without size limits. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send request lines, headers, chunk-size lines or trailers lacking CRLF to grow worker memory and consume CPU, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-134822 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability that allows attackers to tamper with signed parameters by exploiting mis-parsing in CheckSignature() of Saml2RedirectBinding.cs. Attackers can append data after an extra '=' in RelayState of an intercepted or replayed Redirect-binding message, causing applications to trust the tampered value.

item.title: CVE-2026-134823 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | Kitty 0.43.0 before 0.51.0 contains a terminal escape sequence injection vulnerability that allows attackers to emit escape sequences by crafting malicious file or archive member names. When a victim highlights such an entry in the choose-files kitten preview panel, unsanitized names are written raw, enabling OSC 52 clipboard overwrites, OSC 8 links, window title changes, or screen spoofing.

item.title: CVE-2026-134824 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.98 contains a link following vulnerability that allows malicious repositories to read host files by setting --eventpath in an untrusted project .actrc to a symlink. Attackers can commit an event.json symlink pointing to files like ~/.ssh/id_rsa, which act copies into the job container as GITHUB_EVENT_PATH for workflow steps to exfiltrate.

item.title: CVE-2026-134825 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Gradio 6.27.0 before 6.32.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in gradio/history.py that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to use the operator's locally saved Hugging Face token by sending a forged Host: localhost header. When ssr_mode is enabled, requests proxied through the local Node SSR server pass the loopback check, letting attackers call run history endpoints to list buckets, read records and assets, and write buckets under the operator's account.

item.title: CVE-2026-134826 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | erxes before 3.4.14 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the insurance_api plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to create, overwrite or delete contract templates via GraphQL mutations. Attackers can inject HTML into templates rendered by headless Chromium during generateContractPDF to pull internal network content into PDFs and exfiltrate customer fields.

item.title: CVE-2026-134827 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Lightdash before 3.212.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability in getGitlabInstallationRepoReadAccess that sends the organization GitLab app token to unverified hosts. Project developers can set the dbt connection host_domain to an attacker-controlled server and capture the token when the AI agent reads the repository, gaining access to every reachable repository.

item.title: CVE-2026-134828 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Penpot 2.18.0 before 2.19.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the sanitize-svg function that allows authenticated users to bypass filtering through unescaped re-serialization. Attackers with file edit permission can upload SVGs using entity-encoded or CDATA-wrapped markup or attribute quote breakouts to execute JavaScript in the Penpot origin when victims open them.

item.title: CVE-2026-134829 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6 | Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 contains a race condition in two-factor authentication attempt limiting that allows attackers holding a user's password to bypass lockout. Attackers can send many concurrent POST requests to /api/2fa/verify that pass checkRateLimit before recordFailedAttempt runs, brute-forcing TOTP or backup codes beyond the five-attempt limit.

item.title: CVE-2026-134830 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Casdoor before 4.27.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in decodeSamlMessage that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by sending unbounded DEFLATE-compressed SAML messages. Attackers can send a small, highly compressed SAMLRequest or SAMLResponse to the /api/saml/logout/:owner/:application endpoint, which inflates to gigabytes and crashes or stalls the server.

item.title: CVE-2026-134831 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read unpublished help center articles through the public portal API. Attackers can request archived articles by slug via the ArticlesController show actions or read draft translations exposed through associated_articles in article JSON responses.

item.title: CVE-2026-134832 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | Vim 9.2.0405 before 9.2.1352 contains a security bypass vulnerability in expand_tag_fname() that allows attackers to evade 'tagsecure' URL checks by escaping URLs in tags file entries. Attackers can supply a crafted tags file in a cloned repository so that jumping to a tag makes netrw fetch an attacker-controlled URL leaking environment variable values.

item.title: CVE-2026-134833 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | RSSHub before 2026.11.01-8521.e529e9b contains a domain validation bypass in the javdb routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to capture the operator's JAVDB_SESSION cookie. Attackers can pass an absolute javdb.com URL in the category parameter and set the domain query to a host they control, causing processItems to send the _jdb_session cookie there.

item.title: CVE-2026-134834 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in Nextcloud.get_file that allows authenticated recipe editors to write and delete files by using unsanitized recipe names in temporary paths. Attackers can set a recipe name containing ../ segments via PATCH /api/recipe/<pk>/ and request /api/get_recipe_file/<pk>/ to overwrite and remove .pdf files outside the temporary directory.

item.title: CVE-2026-134835 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Langfuse before 4.82.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows organization admins to target internal hosts by setting the GitHub Enterprise SSO baseUrl, which skips outbound-URL validation. Attackers can point baseUrl to loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata addresses so user sign-ins trigger server requests carrying stored OAuth client credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-134836 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Dashy 4.0.0 before 4.9.12 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability in isLocalRequest that attaches user credentials to lookalike hosts due to prefix-only origin checks. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted ?config= link pointing to a lookalike host, capturing bearer tokens or HTTP auth headers to read configuration and stored API keys, or modify them when the victim is an admin.

item.title: CVE-2026-134837 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Frappe before 15.126.0 and 16.x before 16.55.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows Dashboard Manager users to pollute Object.prototype by storing __proto__ keys in Dashboard Chart custom_options. When any user, including administrators, views a dashboard rendering the chart, Object.assign merges attacker properties into Object.prototype, altering Frappe desk client behavior for that session.

item.title: CVE-2026-134838 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1 | Weblate before 2026.11 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the reset_password view that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset victim passwords by abusing case-insensitive Unicode e-mail matching. Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password.

item.title: CVE-2026-134839 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Linkwarden before 2.17.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the archive upload handler that allows collection members with only add permission to modify other users' links. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/v1/archives/<linkId> to replace another user's stored screenshot, PDF, readable, or HTML archive with attacker-supplied content.

item.title: CVE-2026-134840 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | HumHub before 1.19.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController actionNewMemberSearch and actionAdminUserSearch, which skip the checkGroupAccess check. A manager of any single group can query admin-user-search and new-member-search with another group's id parameter to enumerate members, including administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-134859 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in PLYImporter::LoadFace and createFromeTriStrip that fails to validate face vertex indices against the vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted PLY file processed with normal generation but without aiProcess_ValidateDataStructure to crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory into generated normals.

item.title: CVE-2026-134860 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ReadFloat in ColladaLoader.cpp because accessor stride and offset bounds are checked only by ai_assert. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose animation accessor describes more values than its float_array holds to read past the array or dereference null, crashing the importing application.

item.title: CVE-2026-134861 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in glTFAsset.inl that allows attackers to corrupt memory via oversized glTF 1.0 accessor elements. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with VEC4 position or VEC3 index accessors to overflow heap or stack buffers during import, crashing applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-134862 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that uses NORMAL and TEXCOORD accessors without comparing their counts to the POSITION vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with shorter normal or texture coordinate arrays to trigger heap out-of-bounds reads and writes that crash the importing application.

item.title: CVE-2026-134863 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an invalid pointer dereference vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportEmbeddedTextures that derives the texture format hint without checking the strchr result. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with an embedded image mime type lacking a slash to crash the importing application.

item.title: CVE-2026-134864 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that builds TRIANGLE_STRIP and TRIANGLE_FAN faces from unfilled faces. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file whose strip or fan primitives trigger out-of-bounds reads or null pointer dereferences, crashing the importing application.

item.title: CVE-2026-134865 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ColladaParser::CopyVertex that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying primitives lacking a VERTEX input. Attackers can provide a crafted Collada file whose SIZE_MAX per-vertex offset bypasses the release-removed ai_assert check, crashing the importing application.

item.title: CVE-2026-134866 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SkipLine that allows attackers to hang parsing by supplying files with '#' comment lines. Attackers can provide crafted OFF, LWS, or MD3 shader files so ReadFile never returns, consuming a CPU core and denying service.

item.title: CVE-2026-134867 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in FBXConverter::GetRotationKeyframeList that allows attackers to exhaust memory via unbounded rotation angle differences. Attackers can supply a crafted FBX file of about 111 KB whose keyframe interpolation loop never advances, consuming gigabytes of memory until the importing process is killed.

item.title: CVE-2026-134868 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description:
Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ColladaParser::ReadPrimitives that allows attackers to exhaust memory via non-numeric index values. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose

index list contains a non-digit character, causing endless zero-index appends until the importing process crashes.

item.title: CVE-2026-134730 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | A security vulnerability has been detected in xuxueli xxl-job 3.5.0/3.5.1-SNAPSHOT. The affected element is the function insert/update of the file admin/src/main/java/com/xxl/job/admin/business/controller/JobGroupController.java of the component Group Management. The manipulation of the argument addressList leads to cross-site request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
